import base64

    except ImportError:

from ansible.module_utils.urls import fetch_url
api_host = "api.boundary.com"
config_directory = "/etc/bprobe"

def auth_encode(apikey):
    return base64.b64encode(apikey.encode()).decode('utf-8')

def build_url(name, apiid, action, meter_id=None, cert_type=None):
    if action == "create":
        return f"https://{api_host}/{apiid}/meters/{name}"
    elif action == "search":
        return f"https://{api_host}/{apiid}/meters?name={name}"
    elif action == "certificates":
        return f"https://{api_host}/{apiid}/meters/{meter_id}/cert.pem"
    elif action == "delete":
        return f"https://{api_host}/{apiid}/meters/{meter_id}"

def http_request(module, name, apiid, apikey, action, data=None, meter_id=None, cert_type=None):
    if meter_id is None:
        url = build_url(name, apiid, action)
    else:
        if cert_type is None:
            url = build_url(name, apiid, action, meter_id)
        else:
            url = build_url(name, apiid, action, meter_id, cert_type)
    headers = {
        "Authorization": "Basic %s" % auth_encode(apikey),
        "Content-Type": "application/json"
    }
    data = data or {}
    response = fetch_url(module, url, data=data, headers=headers)
    return response

def create_meter(module, name, apiid, apikey):
    meters = search_meter(module, name, apiid, apikey)
    if len(meters) > 0:
        return 0, "Meter " + name + " already exists"
    else:
        response, info = http_request(module, name, apiid, apikey, action="create")
        if info['status'] != 200:
            module.fail_json(msg="Failed to create meter")
        if not os.path.exists(config_directory):
            os.makedirs(config_directory)
        return 0, "Meter " + name + " created"

def search_meter(module, name, apiid, apikey):
    response, info = http_request(module, name, apiid, apikey, action="search")
    if info['status'] != 200:
        module.fail_json(msg="Failed to search meter")
    return json.loads(response)

def get_meter_id(module, name, apiid, apikey):
    meters = search_meter(module, name, apiid, apikey)
    if not meters:
        return None
    return meters[0]['id']

def delete_meter(module, name, apiid, apikey):
    meter_id = get_meter_id(module, name, apiid, apikey)
    if meter_id is None:
        module.fail_json(msg="Meter does not exist")
    response, info = http_request(module, name, apiid, apikey, action="delete", meter_id=meter_id)
    if info['status'] != 200:
        module.fail_json(msg="Failed to delete meter")
    return 0, "Meter deleted successfully"
